generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The introduction of a new thread pool executor for node restarters is clear, but the max number of threads being set to 5 might be misleading if the intention was to have a single-threaded executor similar to the "client" activities. review_comment:
It seems very unlikely that there's more than 1 of these running at a time, I made the thread pool max size 5 just incase.

To make more likely to happen you can run with `-Dtests.nightly=true -Dtests.multiplier=40` and run it repeatedly for a while.

I think there can be 1 to 2 restarter tasks
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/05f80ef058327c1a3d8a911b4872022cb3ff3210/server/src/internalClusterTest/java/org/elasticsearch/snapshots/SnapshotStressTestsIT.java#L284
I might just leave at 5, seeing as it's just a max anyway?
